div.div: Q. 1 فَلْطَحَ He expanded, and made broad, or wide, a round cake of bread; (K, TA;) as also فَرْطَحَ; both mentioned by Abu-l-Faraj: [see art. فرطح: both are app. correct; but the former seems to be the more approved:] and he made broad, or wide, anything. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
